package.name: base_scan_proximity
package.description: Close-range obstacle-proximity safety net using the robot base's own 2D lidar (SICK front+rear, merged/filtered by PAL's omni_base_laser_sensors into /scan) — distinct from the roof-mounted Velodyne used for vehicle and pedestrian classification. Publishes a plain Bool "something is very close" signal, OR'd into school_traffic_control's pedestrian alert alongside its camera+velodyne detection.
